sources.title: Denver Broncos have signed 13 undrafted free agents
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos have signed a total of 13 undrafted free agents. The team has not officially announced these moves as of yet, and we have had 14 announced signings, but it sounds like, for now, the Broncos have signed 13 UDFA’s.
